# The Green Heritage Resort and Banquet

> Official website for **The Green Heritage Resort and Banquet**, a wedding resort, lawn venue, chandelier banquet hall, and family stay property located along Gobarsahi–Sakri Road in Bakarpur, Muzaffarpur, Bihar 844127, India.

## Official Entity & Contact Facts (Verified)
- **Official Name:** The Green Heritage Resort and Banquet
- **Address:** Bakarpur, Gobarsahi–Sakri Road, Muzaffarpur, Bihar 844127, India (Directory listing reference: Mauza Bakarpur, Dariyapur Kafen, Muzaffarpur 844127)
- **Coordinates:** 26.06385, 85.3504979
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 92340 52600
- **Email:** ajay888277@gmail.com
- **Google Maps:** https://www.google.com/maps/place/The+Green+Heritage+Resort+and+Banquet/@26.0638548,85.347923,17z/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/thegreenheritagemuz/
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/thegreenheritagemuz/

## Canonical Pages
- [Home](https://thegreenheritageresort.in/): Overview, wedding celebration films, resort gallery, interactive map, family messages, verified venue facts, and quick answers.
- [The Venue](https://thegreenheritageresort.in/the-venue): Walkthrough films of the campus, lawns, poolside and cottages, plus messages from the Founder/Director and the Verma Family (owners).
- [Celebrations](https://thegreenheritageresort.in/celebrations): Weddings, receptions, haldi, mehendi, sangeet, bridal suites, guest stays, and site tours.
- [Spaces & Halls](https://thegreenheritageresort.in/spaces-and-halls): Open green wedding lawns, chandelier banquet hall, poolside mandap lawns, cottages, and property courtyard.
- [Wedding Films & Gallery](https://thegreenheritageresort.in/wedding-films): Original video reels and photography across ceremonies and grounds.
- [FAQs, Directions & Policies](https://thegreenheritageresort.in/faqs): Direct answers for directions, contact channels, multi-day weddings, rooms, enquiry terms, and privacy policy.
- [Contact & Visit](https://thegreenheritageresort.in/contact): Online date enquiry form, WhatsApp desk, email desk, and interactive Google Maps directions.

## Direct Answers (AEO / GEO Reference)
- **Where is The Green Heritage Resort and Banquet located?** Along Gobarsahi–Sakri Road in Bakarpur (Dariyapur Kafen), Muzaffarpur, Bihar 844127 (Map pin: 26.06385, 85.3504979).
- **How can families contact the resort?** Call or WhatsApp +91 92340 52600 or email ajay888277@gmail.com.
- **Can we host multi-day weddings and guest stays?** Yes. Families host haldi, mehendi, sangeet, baraat, varmala, and pheras across the lawns and indoor banquet hall, and enquire for bridal suites and family guest rooms directly with the desk.
- **Does submitting an online enquiry confirm a reservation?** No. An online or WhatsApp enquiry is a request only. Dates are reserved only after the resort team verifies calendar availability and confirms written booking terms directly.
